modules.name: selection-highlight
modules.description: Asserts a 2px rgb(59,130,246) selection outline is drawn around exactly one element. Reuses bin/frames-check's deterministic colour+shape detector. The worked per-project contributed module (§6): a real project ships this manifest in its own repo pointing at its own module file; here the entry points at review's shipped reference impl so the fixture is self-contained.
